_comment: Hardness manifest — every hook declared with explicit intent. Drift from this file fails L1 CI. See scripts/check-hardness-inventory.mjs.

hooks.rationale: NI-11: skipped/disabled tests (@Disabled, .skip, xit, xtest, @pytest.mark.skip, #[ignore]) must not be committed — open a tracking issue instead

fixture.content: // TODO: bare todo without task id

hooks.rationale: INV-06: bare TODO without task ID is a gate violation
Blocks placeholder/WIP/disabled-test patterns (PLACEHOLDER, FIXME, XXX, HACK, WIP, it.skip etc.) before save
NI-11: blocks @Disabled/@Ignore (Java), pytest.mark.skip/xfail (Python), t.Skip (Go) in source files
Blocks unused TypeScript exports via knip (exits 1 if exports/types arrays non-empty). TypeScript projects only (#156)
INV-12: PII patterns (email, phone, credit card) must not appear in committed files. EJS template rendered at init time; empirical coverage in __tests__/hooks/empirical/hook-fires.test.ts
Designated read-only files (AGENTS.md, LICENSE, package-lock.json, Cargo.lock) must not be edited silently
Dangerous shell commands (rm -rf /, force push, DROP TABLE) must be blocked
SSOT governance documents must not be edited without explicit ADR or amendment. Exit 2 blocks and returns stderr to Claude as error context. Fixed in #402.

EJS template rendered at arbiter init time. Empirical exit-2 coverage in __tests__/hooks/empirical/plan-anchor.test.ts. Two hard-block paths: (1) implementation phase with no active plan (INV-38); (2) Write to new src/ file lacking a valid Existing Code Survey (CANON-16, INV-46). Fixed in #405, extended in #458.
State capture on PostToolUseFailure — not a violation guard, intentionally non-blocking
UserPromptSubmit hard block (exit 2) — completion claims without valid SHA-pinned evidence are rejected; empirical coverage in __tests__/hooks/empirical/done-evidence-guard.test.ts. INV-38.
UserPromptSubmit hard block (exit 2) — premature task-completion claims return stderr to Claude as error context; empirical coverage in __tests__/hooks/empirical/completion-guard.test.ts

Stop event hard block (exit 2) — a completion claim on a task/ship branch (phase != complete) without correlated plan-review + dispatch + gate-pass evidence (branch + sha) is rejected; empirical coverage in __tests__/hooks/empirical/stop-evidence-guard.test.ts. INV-114.
PostToolUse conventional-commit check (INV-22) + track-aware checklist (#724) — non-blocking informational output
UserPromptSubmit context-economy hint — detects task track from changed files + prompt keywords and injects knowledge-map routing guidance (#720). Always exits 0.
PostToolUse format/lint dispatcher — advisory dispatcher, not a guard
PreCompact session state preservation — advisory, intentionally non-blocking
Skill context injector — advisory context injection, not a guard
INV-01: circular TypeScript dependencies detected per-edit via madge; soft-skips when madge not installed. EJS template rendered at init time for TypeScript projects.

#248: Single dispatcher entrypoint — routes events to handler scripts via config table. EJS template renders with language/governance conditional entries. Delegates to individual HARD/ADVISORY handlers; exit code mirrors first non-zero handler.

#1241: Incremental wiki regeneration hook — runs gen-wiki.mjs --changed after commits that touch docs/. Exit 0 if wiki/ not yet bootstrapped. Advisory: wiki drift is caught by the Lint gate at next check-all run.
R1.S5: blocks gh pr create unless .arbiter/gate-pass.json exists with head_sha matching current HEAD. Missing or stale marker exits 2. Bypass: ARBITER_SKIP_GATE_MARKER=1.
Banner hook for ExitPlanMode — informs agent of next step after plan phase; non-blocking

#1265: UserPromptSubmit hard block (exit 2) — while a brainstorm session is active (.arbiter/brainstorm-active marker), /task commands are rejected until the marker is cleared or auto-expires after 24h. Enforces the brainstorm terminal state (design doc + issue, never auto-implement). Not auto-spawnable: requires both a /task stdin prompt and a cwd marker; empirical exit-2 coverage in __tests__/skills/brainstorming.test.ts.
